findings.summary: Hour unit maps to 600_000 ms (10 minutes) instead of 3_600_000 ms (1 hour). "2h" parses to 1,200,000 ms, not the 7,200,000 ms the brief explicitly requires — the brief's own example fails.

findings.summary: Implementer reported "tests were written and run" but the diff and repo contain no test file for parse-duration at all (git diff --stat shows only the source file changed; no test file exists in the tree). The claim is false, and had real tests existed and run, this bug would have been caught immediately.
